contract.selectors: Optional page integer, inclusive range 1 through 10000; sort play|voice; format json|summary. Ten complete rows per page except the last. Defaults: page 1, play, json.
contract.compatibility: Optionless JSON and the operator CLI remain unchanged. JSON metadata layout, label-shortening algorithm and ascending/descending lexical full-tie direction are not pinned by the runtime acceptance module. Summary complete-row assertions bind labels to play, voice and session values.
contract.coverage: 0/1/10/12/13/105 rows; all pages; differing play/voice order; primary ties with opposing secondary/title order in both sorts across the ten-row boundary; full ties; independent legacy golden; exact complete summary rows including BIGINT hours; inclusive page 9999/10000 decode and default selectors; page 10001 rejection before aggregate reads; supplementary Unicode/control/fence/mention/escaping safety and whole-content UTF-16 budget; foreign guilds; malformed/duplicate/unknown/type-confused selectors; empty/out-of-range/outage distinction.
contract.spies: Volatile aggregate predicate with positive read control, including page 10001; empty set-returning member-table readers with a positive COUNT control; statement triggers plus a nontransactional sequence detect even zero-row/rolled-back writes; REST capture permits only private callback and optional original-message edit.
contract.limits: Tests use unchanged snapshots, not concurrent snapshot guarantees. No new date window or collector. Probe counts are not query-count or storage-reader-bound oracles. Valid ceiling pages are decoder units, not 100000-row database fixtures.
contract.mutationTargets: Removing/reversing the secondary descending comparator; swapping summary play/voice formatter arguments; widening decoder page range to i32::MAX; making the upper bound exclusive; raising the shared 10000 constant. These are intended sensitivity targets, not claims of executed mutants.
contract.greenIntegration: Builder consumes this test-only correction in the existing product PR. Preserve all unrelated tests, legacy data/authority/CLI controls, and production refusal. No production opt-in. No changes to withdrawn findings.
